_doc: Rules for the Calendar Dashboard's Important_Dates tab (dashboard/ImportantDates.js). The sync fetches this file from main on every run. standalone: milestones or titles (regex) that are deadlines on their own, so an opening or closing without a partner is not flagged. theme_rules: first pattern (case-insensitive regex) that matches the event's milestone, else its title, sets the theme. decisions: corrections from the daily Claude review (dashboard/review/REVIEW.md); listing keys are 'CAMPUS|YYYY-MM-DD|title' exactly as in dashboard/snapshot/listings.json.
